title: About me
en: I'm Kawan, your home companion. I watch for falls and long periods without movement, remind you about your medicines, keep an eye on your readings, explain health topics in simple words, and contact your caregiver if something seems wrong. I'm not a doctor and I can't diagnose — for that, please see your healthcare team.
ms: Saya Kawan, peneman di rumah anda. Saya memantau jika anda terjatuh atau lama tidak bergerak, mengingatkan anda tentang ubat, memerhati bacaan kesihatan, menerangkan topik kesihatan dengan mudah, dan menghubungi penjaga anda jika ada yang tidak kena. Saya bukan doktor dan tidak boleh membuat diagnosis.

title: Hello
en: Hello! I'm here with you. How are you feeling today? You can ask me about your medicines, a health topic, or say "daily check-in".
ms: Hai! Saya ada di sini bersama anda. Bagaimana perasaan anda hari ini? Anda boleh tanya tentang ubat, topik kesihatan, atau sebut "semakan harian".

title: Thank you
en: You're very welcome. I'm always here if you need me.
ms: Sama-sama. Saya sentiasa ada jika anda perlukan saya.

title: Type 2 diabetes
en: Type 2 diabetes means your body doesn't use insulin well, so sugar builds up in your blood. Over time high sugar can damage the eyes, kidneys, nerves and heart. Taking medicines as prescribed, eating balanced meals (the Malaysian 'suku-suku separuh' plate), staying active and checking your sugar as advised all help keep it under control. A common target your doctor may set is HbA1c around 7% or lower, but your own target is personal.
ms: Diabetes jenis 2 bermaksud badan tidak menggunakan insulin dengan baik, jadi gula terkumpul dalam darah. Lama-kelamaan gula tinggi boleh merosakkan mata, buah pinggang, saraf dan jantung. Makan ubat seperti dipreskripsi, makan seimbang (pinggan 'suku-suku separuh'), aktif bergerak dan memeriksa gula seperti dinasihatkan membantu mengawalnya.

title: Low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia)
en: Low blood sugar (usually below 4 mmol/L) can cause shaking, sweating, hunger, fast heartbeat, confusion or feeling faint. If you feel this: take 15–20 g of fast sugar (e.g. 3–4 sweets, half a glass of fruit juice or regular soft drink), wait 15 minutes and check again; then eat a snack or meal. If you become confused, can't swallow safely or don't improve, call 999. Tell your doctor about any hypos.
ms: Gula darah rendah (biasanya bawah 4 mmol/L) boleh menyebabkan menggigil, berpeluh, lapar, jantung berdebar, keliru atau rasa nak pitam. Jika berlaku: ambil 15–20 g gula cepat (contohnya 3–4 gula-gula atau separuh gelas jus buah), tunggu 15 minit dan periksa semula; kemudian makan snek atau hidangan. Jika keliru, sukar menelan atau tidak bertambah baik, hubungi 999.

title: High blood sugar
en: High blood sugar can make you very thirsty, pass urine often, feel tired or have blurred vision. Drink water, take your medicines as prescribed and check your sugar if you have a meter. If readings stay very high, or you have vomiting, deep fast breathing, drowsiness or confusion, seek urgent medical help.
ms: Gula darah tinggi boleh menyebabkan sangat dahaga, kerap kencing, letih atau penglihatan kabur. Minum air, makan ubat seperti dipreskripsi dan periksa gula jika ada meter. Jika bacaan kekal sangat tinggi, atau ada muntah, nafas laju dan dalam, mengantuk atau keliru, dapatkan bantuan perubatan segera.

title: High blood pressure (hypertension)
en: High blood pressure often has no symptoms, but over time it strains the heart, brain and kidneys. Many people aim for below 140/90 mmHg (your doctor may set a different target). Helpful habits: take medicines daily even when you feel well, reduce salt (less kicap, budu, processed food), stay active, keep a healthy weight and avoid smoking. A reading of 180/120 or higher, especially with chest pain, severe headache, weakness or confusion, needs urgent help.
ms: Darah tinggi selalunya tiada simptom, tetapi lama-kelamaan membebankan jantung, otak dan buah pinggang. Ramai menyasarkan bawah 140/90 mmHg (doktor mungkin menetapkan sasaran lain). Tabiat baik: makan ubat setiap hari walaupun rasa sihat, kurangkan garam (kicap, budu, makanan diproses), aktif bergerak dan elak merokok. Bacaan 180/120 atau lebih, terutamanya dengan sakit dada atau sakit kepala teruk, perlu bantuan segera.

title: Measuring blood pressure at home
en: For an accurate home reading: rest seated for 5 minutes, back supported, feet flat, arm resting at heart level, no coffee or exercise 30 minutes before. Use the right cuff size on bare skin. Take 2 readings 1 minute apart and record both. Measuring at the same times each day makes trends easier for your doctor to read.
ms: Untuk bacaan tepat di rumah: duduk berehat 5 minit, belakang disokong, kaki rata, lengan di paras jantung, tiada kopi atau senaman 30 minit sebelumnya. Guna saiz kaf yang betul pada kulit. Ambil 2 bacaan dengan jarak 1 minit dan catat kedua-duanya.

title: Stroke warning signs (BE-FAST)
en: Remember BE-FAST: Balance loss, Eyes (sudden vision loss), Face drooping, Arm or leg weakness, Speech slurred or strange, Time to call 999. Every minute counts — treatment works best within the first few hours. Note when symptoms started and don't drive yourself.
ms: Ingat BE-FAST: Balance (hilang imbangan), Eyes (penglihatan hilang tiba-tiba), Face (muka senget), Arm (tangan/kaki lemah), Speech (percakapan pelat), Time (masa untuk hubungi 999). Setiap minit penting — rawatan paling berkesan dalam beberapa jam pertama. Catat masa simptom bermula.

title: Heart attack warning signs
en: Heart attack signs include chest pain, pressure or tightness that may spread to the arm, jaw, neck or back, along with shortness of breath, sweating, nausea or feeling faint. Women, older adults and people with diabetes may have milder or unusual symptoms. If you have these, call 999 immediately — don't wait to see if it passes.
ms: Tanda serangan jantung termasuk sakit, tekanan atau rasa ketat di dada yang mungkin merebak ke lengan, rahang, leher atau belakang, bersama sesak nafas, berpeluh, loya atau rasa nak pitam. Wanita, warga emas dan pesakit diabetes mungkin mengalami simptom yang lebih ringan. Jika ada, hubungi 999 segera.

title: Metformin
en: Metformin lowers blood sugar in type 2 diabetes. Take it with or just after meals to reduce stomach upset — nausea or loose stools are common at first and usually settle. On its own it rarely causes low sugar. Tell your doctor before surgery or scans with contrast dye, and if you have kidney problems or are vomiting and can't keep fluids down.
ms: Metformin merendahkan gula darah bagi diabetes jenis 2. Ambil bersama atau selepas makan untuk mengurangkan sakit perut — loya atau cirit-birit biasa pada awalnya dan biasanya hilang. Secara sendirian ia jarang menyebabkan gula rendah. Beritahu doktor sebelum pembedahan atau imbasan dengan pewarna, dan jika ada masalah buah pinggang.

title: Amlodipine
en: Amlodipine relaxes blood vessels to lower blood pressure. Take it at the same time each day. Common side effects include ankle swelling, flushing, headache or dizziness, especially when starting. Don't stop it suddenly without talking to your doctor, and stand up slowly if you feel light-headed.
ms: Amlodipine melegakan salur darah untuk merendahkan tekanan darah. Ambil pada masa yang sama setiap hari. Kesan sampingan biasa termasuk buku lali bengkak, muka merah, sakit kepala atau pening, terutamanya pada awal. Jangan berhenti tiba-tiba tanpa berbincang dengan doktor, dan bangun perlahan-lahan jika rasa pening.

title: Atorvastatin (statins)
en: Statins like atorvastatin lower cholesterol and reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke. Take it at the same time daily. Report unexplained muscle pain, weakness or dark urine to your doctor. Avoid large amounts of grapefruit juice with some statins.
ms: Statin seperti atorvastatin merendahkan kolesterol dan mengurangkan risiko serangan jantung dan strok. Ambil pada masa yang sama setiap hari. Laporkan sakit otot tanpa sebab, lemah atau air kencing gelap kepada doktor.

title: High cholesterol
en: Cholesterol is a fat in the blood. Too much 'bad' LDL cholesterol can clog arteries and raise the risk of heart attack and stroke. Eating less fried and fatty food (santan, fried snacks), more vegetables, fruit and whole grains, staying active and taking prescribed statins all help.
ms: Kolesterol ialah lemak dalam darah. Terlalu banyak kolesterol LDL 'jahat' boleh menyumbat arteri dan meningkatkan risiko serangan jantung dan strok. Kurangkan makanan bergoreng dan berlemak (santan), lebihkan sayur, buah dan bijirin penuh, aktif bergerak dan ambil statin seperti dipreskripsi.

title: HbA1c test
en: HbA1c shows your average blood sugar over about the last 3 months. Many adults with diabetes aim for around 7% or lower, but your doctor may set a different target based on your age and health. It's usually checked every 3–6 months.
ms: HbA1c menunjukkan purata gula darah anda dalam kira-kira 3 bulan lepas. Ramai pesakit diabetes menyasarkan sekitar 7% atau lebih rendah, tetapi doktor mungkin menetapkan sasaran berbeza. Biasanya diperiksa setiap 3–6 bulan.

title: Insulin storage and use
en: Keep unopened insulin in the fridge (not the freezer). The pen you're using can usually stay at room temperature for about 4 weeks — check the leaflet — away from heat and direct sun. Rotate injection sites, and never share pens. If you're unwell and not eating, don't just stop insulin — ask your healthcare team what to do.
ms: Simpan insulin yang belum dibuka dalam peti sejuk (bukan peti beku). Pen yang sedang digunakan biasanya boleh disimpan pada suhu bilik kira-kira 4 minggu — semak risalah — jauh dari haba dan cahaya matahari. Tukar tempat suntikan, dan jangan berkongsi pen.

title: If you miss a dose
en: For most tablets: take the missed dose when you remember, unless it's almost time for the next one — then skip it. Never take a double dose to make up. Some medicines (like insulin, blood thinners or seizure medicines) have special rules, so check the leaflet or ask your pharmacist. I'll let your caregiver know about missed doses so they can help.
ms: Bagi kebanyakan tablet: ambil dos yang tertinggal sebaik teringat, kecuali hampir tiba masa dos seterusnya — langkau sahaja. Jangan ambil dos berganda. Sesetengah ubat (insulin, ubat cair darah, ubat sawan) ada peraturan khas, jadi semak risalah atau tanya ahli farmasi.

title: Paracetamol (Panadol)
en: Paracetamol helps pain and fever. Follow the label: for most adults it's 500 mg–1 g every 4–6 hours, and never more than 4 g in 24 hours (some people, such as those with liver problems or low body weight, need less). Many cold and flu products also contain paracetamol, so check before combining.
ms: Paracetamol membantu melegakan sakit dan demam. Ikut label: bagi kebanyakan orang dewasa 500 mg–1 g setiap 4–6 jam, dan jangan lebih 4 g dalam 24 jam (sesetengah orang perlu kurang). Banyak ubat selesema juga mengandungi paracetamol, jadi semak sebelum menggabungkan.

title: Low-dose aspirin
en: Low-dose aspirin is sometimes prescribed to prevent heart attack or stroke. Take it with food. Tell your doctor about black stools, vomiting blood or unusual bruising. Don't start or stop it on your own, and check with a pharmacist before taking other painkillers like ibuprofen.
ms: Aspirin dos rendah kadang-kadang dipreskripsi untuk mencegah serangan jantung atau strok. Ambil bersama makanan. Beritahu doktor jika najis hitam, muntah darah atau lebam luar biasa. Jangan mula atau berhenti sendiri.

title: Preventing falls at home
en: To lower your risk of falling: keep floors dry and clutter-free, use non-slip mats in the bathroom, add grab bars near the toilet and shower, keep a light on at night, wear well-fitting shoes, stand up slowly, and do gentle balance exercises. Ask your doctor to review medicines that make you drowsy or dizzy, and get your eyes checked yearly.
ms: Untuk mengurangkan risiko jatuh: pastikan lantai kering dan bebas sepah, guna tikar anti-gelincir di bilik air, pasang palang pemegang dekat tandas, biarkan lampu menyala pada waktu malam, pakai kasut yang sesuai, bangun perlahan-lahan, dan lakukan senaman imbangan ringan.

title: What to do after a fall
en: After a fall: stay calm and check for pain before moving. If you're hurt, feel dizzy or can't get up, stay still, keep warm and call for help — I can alert your caregiver. If you feel able, roll onto your side, get onto hands and knees, crawl to a sturdy chair and slowly push up. Always tell your doctor about a fall, even if you feel fine.
ms: Selepas jatuh: bertenang dan periksa jika ada sakit sebelum bergerak. Jika cedera, pening atau tak boleh bangun, kekal di tempat, panaskan badan dan minta bantuan — saya boleh maklumkan penjaga anda. Jika mampu, berguling ke sisi, merangkak ke kerusi yang kukuh dan bangun perlahan-lahan. Beritahu doktor tentang setiap kejadian jatuh.

title: Dehydration
en: In Malaysia's heat it's easy to get dehydrated, especially for older adults who feel less thirsty. Signs include dark urine, dry mouth, dizziness and tiredness. Sip water through the day — around 6–8 glasses for most people unless your doctor has told you to limit fluids (for example with heart or kidney problems).
ms: Dalam cuaca panas Malaysia mudah berlaku dehidrasi, terutamanya warga emas yang kurang rasa dahaga. Tandanya air kencing gelap, mulut kering, pening dan letih. Minum air sedikit demi sedikit sepanjang hari — sekitar 6–8 gelas kecuali doktor menasihatkan menghadkan cecair.

title: Dengue fever
en: Dengue causes high fever, headache, pain behind the eyes, body aches and sometimes a rash. Danger often comes when the fever starts to drop (day 3–7). Seek help urgently for severe stomach pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding gums or nose, black stools, drowsiness or restlessness. Use paracetamol for fever — avoid ibuprofen and aspirin unless a doctor says otherwise — and drink plenty of fluids.
ms: Denggi menyebabkan demam tinggi, sakit kepala, sakit belakang mata, sakit badan dan kadang-kadang ruam. Bahaya selalunya apabila demam mula turun (hari 3–7). Dapatkan bantuan segera jika sakit perut teruk, muntah berterusan, gusi atau hidung berdarah, najis hitam atau mengantuk. Guna paracetamol untuk demam — elakkan ibuprofen dan aspirin — dan minum banyak air.

title: Fever
en: A temperature of 38°C or higher is a fever. Rest, drink fluids and use paracetamol as directed. See a doctor if it lasts more than 2–3 days, goes above 39.5°C, or comes with a stiff neck, rash, breathing difficulty, confusion, or if you have diabetes or a weak immune system. In Malaysia, consider dengue if fever is high with body aches.
ms: Suhu 38°C atau lebih ialah demam. Berehat, minum air dan guna paracetamol seperti diarahkan. Jumpa doktor jika berlarutan lebih 2–3 hari, melebihi 39.5°C, atau disertai leher kaku, ruam, sesak nafas, keliru. Di Malaysia, pertimbangkan denggi jika demam tinggi dengan sakit badan.

title: Blood oxygen (SpO2)
en: SpO2 is the percentage of oxygen in your blood, measured with a finger clip. For most healthy people it's 95–100%. Readings below 92% that persist, or any drop with breathlessness, need medical attention (some lung conditions have lower personal targets). Cold fingers, nail polish or movement can give false low readings — warm your hands, sit still and re-check.
ms: SpO2 ialah peratusan oksigen dalam darah, diukur dengan klip jari. Bagi kebanyakan orang sihat ia 95–100%. Bacaan bawah 92% yang berterusan, atau penurunan bersama sesak nafas, perlu rawatan. Jari sejuk, pengilat kuku atau pergerakan boleh memberi bacaan rendah palsu — panaskan tangan, duduk diam dan periksa semula.

title: Heart rate
en: A normal resting heart rate for adults is about 60–100 beats per minute. It goes up with activity, fever, stress, caffeine or dehydration. A resting rate that stays above 120, below 45, or feels very irregular — especially with dizziness, chest pain or breathlessness — should be checked by a doctor.
ms: Kadar jantung rehat normal orang dewasa ialah kira-kira 60–100 denyutan seminit. Ia naik ketika aktiviti, demam, tekanan, kafein atau dehidrasi. Kadar rehat yang kekal melebihi 120, bawah 45, atau sangat tidak teratur — terutamanya dengan pening atau sakit dada — perlu diperiksa doktor.

title: Healthy eating (suku-suku separuh)
en: Malaysia's 'suku-suku separuh' plate is a simple guide: half the plate vegetables and fruit, a quarter protein (fish, chicken, eggs, tofu, beans), and a quarter rice or other carbs — preferably brown rice or whole grains. Go easy on sugar in teh tarik, santan, fried foods and salty sauces, and drink plain water.
ms: Pinggan sihat Malaysia 'suku-suku separuh': separuh pinggan sayur dan buah, suku protein (ikan, ayam, telur, tauhu, kekacang), dan suku nasi atau karbohidrat lain — lebih baik beras perang atau bijirin penuh. Kurangkan gula dalam teh tarik, santan, makanan bergoreng dan sos masin.

title: Staying active
en: Most adults benefit from about 150 minutes of moderate activity a week — for example a 30-minute walk on 5 days — plus gentle strength and balance exercises. If you're recovering or have heart, lung or joint problems, start small (even 5–10 minutes) and ask your doctor or physiotherapist what's safe. Stop if you get chest pain, severe breathlessness or dizziness.
ms: Kebanyakan orang dewasa mendapat manfaat daripada kira-kira 150 minit aktiviti sederhana seminggu — contohnya berjalan 30 minit selama 5 hari — serta senaman kekuatan dan imbangan ringan. Jika dalam pemulihan, mulakan sedikit (5–10 minit) dan tanya doktor apa yang selamat.

title: Sleep
en: Most adults need 7–9 hours of sleep. Helpful habits: keep regular sleep and wake times, avoid caffeine after mid-afternoon, keep the room cool and dark, put screens away an hour before bed, and avoid heavy meals late at night. Tell your doctor about loud snoring with pauses in breathing, or poor sleep lasting weeks.
ms: Kebanyakan orang dewasa perlukan 7–9 jam tidur. Tabiat baik: tidur dan bangun pada waktu yang tetap, elak kafein selepas petang, bilik sejuk dan gelap, jauhkan skrin sejam sebelum tidur. Beritahu doktor jika berdengkur kuat dengan henti nafas, atau susah tidur berminggu-minggu.

title: Stress, loneliness and mood
en: Feeling low, stressed or lonely is common, especially when unwell or living alone — and it's okay to ask for support. Small steps help: a daily routine, short walks, talking to someone you trust, and enjoyable activities. If low mood lasts more than two weeks, talk to your doctor. You can call Talian HEAL 15555 or Befrienders (03-7627 2929) any time. If you think about harming yourself, call 999.
ms: Rasa sedih, tertekan atau sunyi adalah biasa, terutamanya ketika sakit atau tinggal seorang diri — dan tidak salah meminta sokongan. Langkah kecil membantu: rutin harian, berjalan sebentar, berbual dengan orang yang dipercayai. Jika berlarutan lebih dua minggu, berjumpa doktor. Anda boleh hubungi Talian HEAL 15555 atau Befrienders (03-7627 2929). Jika terfikir untuk mencederakan diri, hubungi 999.

title: Foot care with diabetes
en: Diabetes can reduce feeling in the feet, so small cuts may go unnoticed. Check your feet daily (use a mirror or ask someone), wash and dry well between the toes, moisturise but not between toes, never walk barefoot, and wear comfortable shoes. See a doctor promptly for any wound, redness, swelling, or a wound that isn't healing.
ms: Diabetes boleh mengurangkan rasa di kaki, jadi luka kecil mungkin tidak disedari. Periksa kaki setiap hari, basuh dan keringkan celah jari, jangan berjalan tanpa kasut, dan pakai kasut yang selesa. Jumpa doktor segera jika ada luka, kemerahan, bengkak atau luka yang tidak sembuh.

title: Kidney health
en: Diabetes and high blood pressure are the main causes of kidney disease in Malaysia. Keeping sugar and blood pressure controlled, staying hydrated, limiting salt, and avoiding regular use of painkillers like ibuprofen without advice protect your kidneys. Your doctor checks kidney function with blood (eGFR) and urine tests.
ms: Diabetes dan darah tinggi ialah punca utama penyakit buah pinggang di Malaysia. Mengawal gula dan tekanan darah, cukup minum air, kurangkan garam, dan elak ubat tahan sakit seperti ibuprofen tanpa nasihat melindungi buah pinggang anda.

title: Using an inhaler (asthma/COPD)
en: For a standard puffer: shake it, breathe out fully, seal your lips around the mouthpiece, press once as you start a slow deep breath in, then hold your breath for about 10 seconds. A spacer helps a lot. Rinse your mouth after steroid inhalers. If your reliever isn't helping or you're too breathless to speak, call 999.
ms: Untuk inhaler biasa: goncang, hembus nafas sepenuhnya, kemam bibir pada corong, tekan sekali sambil mula menarik nafas perlahan dan dalam, kemudian tahan nafas kira-kira 10 saat. Spacer sangat membantu. Berkumur selepas inhaler steroid. Jika inhaler pelega tidak membantu atau terlalu sesak untuk bercakap, hubungi 999.

title: Recovering at home after hospital
en: Recovering at home goes best with: taking medicines exactly as prescribed, gentle activity as advised, good food and fluids, rest, and keeping follow-up appointments. Watch for warning signs your team gave you — such as fever, increasing pain, wound redness or discharge, breathlessness or leg swelling — and contact them early. I'll keep track and share a report you can bring to your next visit.
ms: Pemulihan di rumah paling baik dengan: makan ubat tepat seperti dipreskripsi, aktiviti ringan seperti dinasihatkan, makanan dan air yang cukup, rehat, dan hadir temujanji susulan. Perhatikan tanda amaran seperti demam, sakit bertambah, luka merah atau bernanah, sesak nafas atau kaki bengkak — dan hubungi doktor awal.
